# design-vault-plugin

> A DeepSeek Harness plugin.

## Install

    dsh plugin --profile web add design-vault-plugin

## Verify

    dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A2 "id: design-vault-plugin"

## Develop

    pnpm install
    pnpm verify

## Read next

- README.md — user guide
- AGENTS.md — repository rules and invariants
- src/host/ — Host half
- src/client/ — browser half
- tests/ — both suites

## Contracts

- Package: design-vault-plugin
- Patch row: `design-vault-plugin`
- Client module id: `design-vault-plugin`
